blocks.title: Advanced Python concepts
blocks.text: Advanced Python tasawwurat bunyadi ilm par bante hain ta ke programmers zyada pecheeda kaam sambhal sakein; yeh hissa exception handling (ghaltiyon ko saleeqe se sambhalna) aur file handling (files parhna aur likhna) batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke do advanced topics bataiye.

items: Advanced topics: mazboot programs ke liye exception handling aur file handling.
